heading: Court Board
description: Club session signups: one link per session, a live rule-ordered list, no accounts.

lab.lede: Sign up for a club session with one link.
lab.intro: Court Board replaces a comment-your-name thread. Each session has its own link, usually posted in the group chat. Open it, take a place, and the list works out the order from the club's rules.
howItWorks: Open the session link your organiser shared.
Enter your name, mobile number and a 6-digit PIN you choose the first time.
Use the same number and PIN to change or cancel from any device.
lab.noLinkNote: There is nothing to browse here. Ask your organiser for the session link.
lab.demoNote: You are running on the in-memory demo store. Nothing here is saved to AWS and it resets when the server restarts.

byField.name: Enter a name of up to 40 characters.
byField.guests: Check your guests' names and tiers.

byField.endTime: The end time must be after the start.

session.closedNotice: The register for this session is closed.
session.startedNotice: This session has started, so new places can no longer be taken.
session.beforeRelease: Waitlists move up {release}. Free cancellation until {cutoff}.
session.afterCutoff: Free cancellation has ended. Cancelling a place now puts you on hold. Leaving a waitlist is always free.

signup.heading: Take a place
signup.phoneHelp: Never shown to anyone. It is how we know a place is yours.
signup.pinHelp: First time? Choose one. You'll use it to cancel from any device.
signup.guestsHelpUnlimited: Bring as many guests as you like.
signup.pinSetNote: Your PIN is set. Use it with your number to change or cancel from any device.
signup.manageHint: Need to change or cancel? Your place is open under Manage my place below.

manage.heading: Manage my place
manage.intro: Enter your number and PIN to see your places, change details, or cancel.
manage.pinHelp: If an organiser has reset your PIN, enter the new one you want to use.
manage.forgotten: Forgotten your PIN? Ask an organiser to reset it.
manage.noPlace: You don't have a place in this session.
manage.holdNotice: You are on hold until {date}. Your places join the External band until then.
manage.guestsUnlimited: You can add as many guests as you like.
manage.guestsFull: You have reached the guest limit for now.
manage.cancelHostNote: Cancelling your place also cancels your guests.
manage.freeGrace: Free to cancel until {time}. You moved up after the cutoff.
manage.freeWaitlist: Leaving the waitlist is always free.
manage.penalty: Cancelling now puts you on hold for {weeks} {weekUnit} (until {date}).
manage.closedNote: This session is closed, so places can't be changed.

organiser.invalidHeading: This organiser link is not valid
organiser.invalidBody: It may have been replaced. Ask the person who runs the club for the current link.

current.empty: There are no sessions yet. Create the first one.
current.cancelledNote: This session has been cancelled. Nobody was put on hold.
current.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
current.copyNext: New session: copy this one to {date}
current.cancelSessionBody: Nobody will be put on hold. The signup link will say the session is cancelled.

register.heading: Register
register.empty: Nobody has taken a place yet.
register.removeBody: Their Seat is cancelled and they are not put on hold. Removing a Host seat removes its guests too.
register.closeNotStarted: You can close the register once the session has started.
register.cancelledNote: A cancelled session has no register.
register.closeNoHolds: Nobody will be put on hold.
register.closeHoldsHeading: These Players will be put on hold:

holds.heading: On hold
holds.resetBody: The Player chooses a new PIN the next time they take a place or open Manage my place.

newSession.heading: New session
newSession.intro: Sessions open for signups straight away. Release, Top-up and the Cutoff follow the club's rules.
newSession.copiedNote: Copied from the current session and moved on a week. Adjust anything that changes.

link.heading: Organiser link
link.body: Anyone with this link can run the club. Replace it if it has been shared too widely.
link.rotateBody: The current link stops working straight away, for everyone. This browser stays signed in.
link.newWarning: This is shown once. The old link has stopped working. Share the new one with the other organisers.
